questions.question_text:
The ratio of $a:b$ is $5:3$.
What fraction of the total is $a$?

options.why: Read off the second number of the ratio, giving the fraction of the total that is $b$.
Compared $a$ with $b$ instead of with the total of $8$ parts.
Made both slips at once: used $b$ as the part and compared it with $a$ rather than with the total.
Counted the shaded squares instead of the unshaded ones.
Compared the $3$ unshaded squares with the $4$ shaded squares instead of with the whole bar.
Made both slips at once: counted the shaded squares and compared them with the unshaded squares.

questions.question_text:
The ratio of $a:b$ is $2:7$.
$b$ is what fraction of $a$?

options.why: Wrote the comparison the wrong way round, giving $a$ as a fraction of $b$.
Compared $b$ with the total number of parts instead of with $a$.
Used $a$ as the numerator and the total as the denominator.

questions.question_text:
The ratio of $a:b$ is $5:8$.
What fraction of the total is $b$?

options.why: Used the first part, $a$, instead of the second part, $b$.
Compared $b$ with $a$ instead of with the total of $13$ parts.
Compared $a$ with $b$ instead of comparing $b$ with the total.

questions.question_text:
In a class, $\frac{5}{9}$ of the students are girls.
What fraction of the class are boys?

options.why: Repeated the fraction of the class that are girls instead of finding the remaining fraction.
Compared the boys with the girls instead of with the whole class.
Compared the girls with the boys instead of comparing the boys with the whole class.

questions.question_text:
A drink is made of yoghurt and water in the ratio $7:2$.
What fraction of the drink is water?

options.why: Gave the fraction of the drink that is yoghurt instead of the water.
Compared the water with the yoghurt instead of with the whole drink of $9$ parts.
Made both slips at once: took the yoghurt as the part and compared it with the water rather than with the whole drink.

questions.question_text:
A shelf holds novels and comics.
There are four times as many novels as comics.
What fraction of the books are comics?

options.why: Compared the comics with the novels instead of with all the books.
Gave the fraction of the books that are novels.
Subtracted one part from four parts instead of adding to find the total.

questions.question_text:
The ratio of red to green counters is $4:7$.
The number of red counters is what fraction of the number of green counters?

options.why: Reversed the comparison, giving green counters as a fraction of red counters.
Compared the red counters with all $11$ parts instead of with the green counters.
Gave the green counters as a fraction of all the counters instead of red as a fraction of green.
